Shri Jahangir M. Poonegar - advocate for the appellan
 Shri Vibhash Khedekar - Advocate for the respondent N
 Shri Bhashkar Agrawal - Advocate for the respondent N
 Order

This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 is preferred being aggrieved by the award dated 30.10.2023 passed by Second MACT, Sendhwa, District Barwani in Claim Case No.123 of 2022 for enhancement of Rs.1,00,000/-.
2. Only quantum of compensation is involved in this appeal, accordingly, the facts are being stated briefly.

In an application under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicle Act, a compensation of Rs.11,47,000/-was awarded for the death of Gyarsiya aged 45 years, by profession Labour and husband of appellant No.1, father of appellants No. 2 to 5 and son of appellant No.6 died on 31.10.2021 in a motor vehicular accident.

3. The tribunal calculated loss of dependency including the monthly income as Rs. 6,500/- per month and awarded the compensation as follows :-

dependency 9,10,000/-
For Rs 44,000 + 1,60,000/- = Rs 2,04,000/-
Consortium Funeral Rs.16,500/-

1 expenses Loss of estate Rs 16,500/-
Total amount Rs 11,47,000 4.
This appeal has been preferred on the ground that per month income has been assessed on the lower side and there is a calculation mistake regarding loss of consortium.

5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.
The counsel for the respondent opposed the prayer and submitted that awarded amount by the Tribunal is appropriate and proper.
No further interference is required.
7. The tribunal ought to have assessed the per month income as Rs.8,500/- and 25% ought to have added for future prospect.
The tribunal ought to have awarded loss of consortium to all the appellants, at par.
On re- calculation, the compensation for consortium comes to Rs. 2,64,000/-.
The Tribunal has assessed only Rs.2,04,000/-.
Hence, a sum of Rs.3,40,000/- (Rs 2,80,000 + Rs 60,000) is further enhanced.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.
8. The appellant has valued the appeal only to the extent of Rs.1,00,000/- and paid the Court fee accordingly.

However, for the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:7237 3 MA-3033-2024 remaining amount, the Court fee shall be paid by the appellant within a period of one month and thereafter the amount shall be released by the Insurance Company on receiving the certificate.

In case the certificate has not been filed before the Insurance Company up to a period of three months,
the claimant shall not be entitled to receive the interest on the enhanced amount of compensation.
9. Accordingly, appeal is disposed of to the extent indicated herein above.
(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE rashmi Pankhi Bai vs Akash on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/162771775/
